title: THE LAST BUS

floorplan.camera: on the pavement at standing height, looking west along Oxford Street toward Oxford Circus, the ghost bus in the near lane

anchors.OXFORD STREET: the wide wet roadway running from the foreground to Oxford Circus, empty of traffic
anchors.ROUTEMASTER: the ghost bus in the near lane, a 1956 London Transport Routemaster, its rear open platform level with the pavement
anchors.DEPARTMENT STORE WINDOWS: the long lit shop windows along the right-hand pavement, mannequins posed inside
anchors.BUS STOP: a temporary bus stop on the left-hand pavement, its timetable blank
anchors.PEDESTRIANISATION WORKS: barriers, exposed paving and a row of new bollards along the left-hand kerb

cast.depth: inside the bus's open rear platform recess at pavement level, midground frame-right, the bus roof rising high above him
cast.action: stands inside the bus's open rear platform recess with both boots on the platform floor at pavement level, one white-gloved hand on the vertical grab pole, the other raised with the brass ticket punch; the red body of the bus frames him on both sides; his porcelain mask catches the sodium light; the long coat tails hang still; he looks down the pavement toward Wyatt

cast.depth: midground frame-right, under the store awning
cast.action: leans against the department-store window with her right hand tucked under her left arm and her left hand resting on her right sleeve, one eyebrow raised, watching the bus with heavy-lidded boredom; the deep-red scarf draped loosely around her throat, one end hanging

cast.depth: foreground frame-left at the bus stop
cast.action: holds a small black notebook open in her right hand and a pencil in her left, looking up at the bus's black destination blind, her coat collar up, one foot on the bus stop's kerb

cast.depth: foreground, a step into the roadway between the bus and the others
cast.action: stands between the bus and the others, left arm extended sideways at waist height, palm open — a barrier — his right hand loose at his side, masked face tilted up toward the rear platform

cast.depth: low in frame at Lucy's heels
cast.action: stands rigid at Lucy's heels, nose lifted high scenting the wet street toward the bus, ears pricked, tail low and still

props.anchor: ROUTEMASTER: in the near lane, its rear open platform level with the pavement
props.description: a 1956 London Transport Routemaster in deep bus red, seen from the rear: a rounded roof, a deep open rear platform recess with a step, a vertical grab pole from floor to ceiling and a staircase behind it; the destination blind black with a single white ring; a small black rear route blind above the open platform shows the same single white ring; warm amber interior lights behind steamed windows; through the rear lower window the pale blank face and shoulders of one seated mannequin are clearly visible, the others dark shapes behind it; the Conductor stands inside the open platform recess; the driver's cab dark and empty; the bus is a solid prop vehicle standing on its wheels
props.state: the bus is silent, its engine off, its interior lights on; the mannequin passengers sit inside, one pale blank face visible through the rear lower window; the driver's seat bare; the white ring on the rear route blind is the only mark; the Conductor's boots are on the platform floor inside the recess

props.anchor: ROUTEMASTER: seated inside behind the steamed windows
props.description: six display mannequins, jointed wooden-and-plaster figures with blank faces, dressed in 2026 high-street coats, seated upright, each holding a closed black umbrella
props.state: the mannequins are display figures sitting perfectly still, their blank faces turned slightly toward the windows

props.anchor: ROUTEMASTER: raised in his white-gloved hand
props.description: a heavy brass bus conductor's ticket punch on a chain, its jaws open

props.anchor: BUS STOP: open in Lucy's right hand
props.description: a small black pocket notebook, open, its pages blank; a pencil in her left hand

moment: The last night buses have gone; the street is empty except for a Routemaster with a black blind and a white ring. The Conductor raises his punch. In the department-store windows, the mannequins seem to turn. Wyatt steps into the road.
environment: Oxford Street at one in the morning: wet charcoal asphalt, closed shopfronts, long department-store windows lit from within, a temporary bus stop pole on the left pavement topped by a blank white disc atop a plain pole, a row of stubby black bollards along the near left kerb with their bases ringed by temporary yellow tape, blank grey barrier panels stacked behind them, a single street sweeper's cart far down the pavement, the Routemaster the only vehicle in motion; the store windows are full of mannequins in 2026 coats; every surface plain and unlettered, with blank hoardings.
lighting: sodium-amber street lamps and cold blue night; the bus's warm amber interior glowing through steamed windows; wet asphalt doubling the lights; the Conductor's porcelain mask lit from below by the bus; long shadows across the empty lane.
colour: full colour — charcoal wet asphalt, sodium amber, deep London bus red, warm amber interior; Akane's deep-red scarf the only other red; the rest of the palette near-monochrome.
negatives: destination blinds, timetables, tickets, shop signs and badges are plain blank panels of colour
